Subject: nov 21 charity stream — linden pantry

@everyone charity stream is SATURDAY NOV 21, 10am–10pm eastern. put it in your calendar now so this isn't news to half the server when we're already live lol

we're raising $600 for Linden Community Pantry. last year we raised $212, which mattered, but i posted way too late and a bunch of ppl missed it. giving everyone an actual heads up this time.

donate here: lindenpantry.example/mrkz
it goes straight to the pantry, nothing taken off. rook is matching the first $100 people donate, so those first donations count double. even $3 helps: through their wholesale partner, every $1 gets about 4 pounds of food.

they're serving around 340 families a week rn, and denise said the shelves are the lowest she's seen before Thanksgiving. let's help get some food on them.

the incentives:
$100 — full round with my controller upside down
$250 — chat picks my hair dye color and i do it ON STREAM
$400 — an hour of chat-picked songs, no skipping
$600 — i vlog a grocery pickup arranged by the pantry. they buy the food with the donations, not me

yes charity streams can be a little cringe. i'm willing to accept that while you make terrible decisions about my hair. it's not begging if u get hair dye content out of it lol

first half is community lobbies, anyone can join and i'll drop the code. second half, chat votes on a game every 2 hours. no repeat maps, larry, i heard you.

no card or no money to spare? you're still invited. come play, hang out, share this with a friend, or remind people closer to the day. canned and boxed food can also go in the pantry's blue bin by the side door, Saturdays 9am–1pm.

donating isn't the entry fee. i'd love to have you there either way. nov 21. potentially my last day with normal hair.
